title: Combine a remembered trip with a public weather lookup

arguments.content: Flying to Istanbul on Friday for a conference

web_search.title: Istanbul weather
web_search.snippets: Rain expected in Istanbul Friday through Sunday, highs of 14°C.

turns.user: Do I need an umbrella for my trip?

reply.judge: She knows the trip is Istanbul on Friday without asking, looks up the weather, and says rain is expected.
